message:
Running command: cd /tmp/decseeds && for f in testdata/poc/*; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '%s ' "$f"; sha1sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi; done | grep -E '91a5bed|fa06784' || true && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('testdata/poc').glob('*'):
    data=p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else b''
    if data[:4] in (b'DKIF',b'\x20\x20\x20\x20') or b'AV01' in data[:64] or b'OBU' in data[:64]:
        print(len(data), p.name, data[:32].hex(), data[:16])
PY
